tools.name: list_entries
tools.description: The day's standup entries as JSON. Each has updatedBy: 'person' means the person edited it in the window.

tools.name: save_entry
tools.description: Creates one teammate's update for the day, or changes the texts passed and keeps the others, in the teammate's own words. Refuses to empty an entry, and to change one the person edited unless expectedUpdatedAt is its current updatedAt.

tools.name: show_standup
tools.description: Shows the day's entries as a card in the chat.
